a2-unit-26.26.1 A new roommate:
Lucy: OK, Ben, we have three messages from people who want to rent Emma's old room. I asked everyone to write a few lines about themselves.
Ben: Great. That will give us an idea of their personalities.
Lucy: Right. So, the first one is from Derek. He says he needs the biggest bedroom and a parking space.
Ben: That's very rude. Emma's room is the smallest one! And we don't even have a parking space.
Lucy: I know. He also says he often has friends over until three in the morning, and he wants to pay the rent when he can.
Ben: Really? That's strange. Maybe he's a bit dishonest.
Lucy: I agree. We'd be crazy to choose Derek. He sounds like trouble. What about the next one?
Ben: This one is from Priya. She says she's a medical student.
Lucy: Wow. I guess she's really smart. That's a difficult course.
Ben: Yes, and she does yoga and bakes her own bread. She seems cheerful!
Lucy: And she even says thank you for reading her message. She's so polite!
Ben: OK, the last one is from Sam.
Lucy: Oh, I know Sam. He comes into City Coffee every morning.
Ben: What's he like?
Lucy: He's all right, but he's a little miserable. He never smiles, and he plays the drums in a heavy metal band.
Ben: Hmm. I'm not sure I want to hear drums every night.
Lucy: And I'm surprised he wants to share an apartment. I thought he was too shy. He told me he was really happy living by himself.
Ben: Let's go with Priya, then. She sounds great!
Lucy: I agree. I'll text her right now.
